name: roly-poly-toy-generator
description: Local roly-poly toy design explorer. Runs FastAPI backend and Vite frontend together.

scripts.dev:backend: python -m uv run --no-sync uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 --app-dir backend
scripts.build:exe: python -m uv run pyinstaller --noconfirm --clean --name roly-poly-toy-generator --onedir --windowed --paths . --distpath build/pyinstaller-dist --workpath build/pyinstaller-work backend/app/launcher.py
